Specification of State Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_SM_CONSTR_00024] Existence of StateMachine Off state
⌈
Each config-
ured
StateMachine
of type
Agent
shall have corresponding "Off"
StateMachine
State
configured, at the time when the creation of the manifest is finished.
⌋
[SWS_SM_CONSTR_00011] ActionListItems allowed in the "Off" state of a
StateMachine of type Agent
⌈
In the
ActionList
referencing the "Off" State of a
StateMachine
of type
Agent
, only the following
ActionListItems
shall be al-
lowed:
•
Function Group
::
Off
•
NmNetworkHandle
::
NoCom
•
SYNC
•
Sleep
⌋
It is recommended that any
StateMachine State
from the
StateMachine
of type
Controller
containing MachineFG::Shutdown or MachineFG::Restart should stop
all
StateMachines
of type
Agent
. By not doing so, the still running processes would
be abruptly terminated when host is shut down.
To keep a consistent
Function Group State
it is needed, that no
Function
Group
is controlled by different
StateMachines
, as it would not be clear which
StateMachine
is finally responsible.
